notes.title: A Wake Inn Update# 2.0
notes.content:
[u]Update #2.0 Changelist:[/u]

- Added 'Finger tracking' for Oculus Touch and Valve Index
- Fixed problem with accidental wheelchair movement while reaching lower drawers
- Doctor Finnegan now comments more places in the hotel
- Added joystick/joypad turning 
- Added joystick step rotation turning
- Improved inventory menagement 
- Added Swap Tool additional button (B on Valve Index and B and Y on Oculus Touch)
- Changed default bindings for Valve Index (Interaction is now under Trigger and Specific actions are now under Grip)
